Definition: from G3844 and G2281; along the sea, i.e. maritime (lacustrine):--upon the sea coast.
BiblicalUsage: Parathalassios means along the sea, upon the sea coast. It appears once, in Matthew 4:13, where Jesus leaves Nazareth and dwells in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sea-coast town was the right place for a ministry that would call fishermen, and prophecy had named the borders long before He came.
